clamav.distribution_requirements: ClamAV is installed from an external package manager, not embedded in this application's bundle. Redistributing ClamAV requires its GPLv2 copyright, license and corresponding-source compliance, plus review of its third-party component notices in upstream COPYING.
clamav.use: Required separately installed clamscan and FreshClam executables.

pypdf.distribution_requirements: Retain BSD-3-Clause copyright, license conditions and disclaimer in source or binary redistributions. Version 5.9.0 remains in portable CI only; the Enhanced requirements file selects 6.21.3.
pypdf.use: Optional strict PDF parsing and CI fixtures, not the Built-in scan gate.

pillow.distribution_requirements: Preserve the MIT-CMU copyright and permission notices in distributed copies; check licenses of additional native libraries included in any redistributed image wheel.
pillow.use: Optional test and sanitization image handling.

cryptography.distribution_requirements: Choose and satisfy an offered license route; preserve required copyright and permission notices, Apache 2.0 license and NOTICE obligations where applicable, and review any bundled native components when redistributing.
cryptography.use: Optional PDF sanitization validation dependencies in CI.

pymupdf.distribution_requirements: For the AGPLv3 route, comply with applicable source-availability, copyright, license and producer-notice obligations for MuPDF and PyMuPDF. If proprietary distribution cannot meet those terms, obtain an Artifex commercial license; repository AGPL alone is not clearance.
pymupdf.use: Isolated optional Maximum PDF rendering worker, not the installed Built-in gate.
